# WebHookRegistration

A web hook: a URL Maitento calls whenever something of one type changes, such as an interaction run or an uploaded file.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | [`WebHookType`](web-hook-type.md) | What the web hook reports on. |
| `url` | `string` | The URL Maitento calls. |
| `signedOnly` | `boolean` | Whether deliveries are only signed, with `X-MT-WebHook-Timestamp` and `X-MT-WebHook-Signature`. Every web hook registered now is. False is one registered before deliveries were signed: its deliveries also carry the secret itself in `X-MT-WebHook-Secret`, so its receiver goes on working. Update it with `signedOnly: true` once the receiver checks the signature; that can't be undone. |
| `headers` | `map<string, string>` | Extra HTTP headers sent with every call. Values are write-only: a response shows each as `********`. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "AppProcess",
  "url": "...",
  "signedOnly": false,
  "headers": {
    "key": "..."
  },
  "tenantId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "dateCreated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
  "dateUpdated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`webhooks.create`](../api/webhooks.md) (`POST /web-hooks`)
- [`webhooks.get`](../api/webhooks.md) (`GET /web-hooks/by-id/{id}`)
- [`webhooks.list`](../api/webhooks.md) (`GET /web-hooks`)
- [`webhooks.update`](../api/webhooks.md) (`PUT /web-hooks/by-id/{id}`)
